user.title: Skylight Family Calendar
user.description:
Visual setup wizard. This creates filter toggles, a view selector, optional Local Calendars, and a Family Calendar dashboard using **Week Planner Card Plus**.

How many family members (personal calendars) do you want?

member.title: Person {n} of {total}
member.description: Pick an existing calendar, or leave it empty and enable **Create Local Calendar if missing** so the wizard creates one named after this person.

shared.title: Shared calendars & weather
shared.description: Optional shared calendars. Holidays usually come from Settings → Devices & services → Holiday.

options.title: Finish
options.description:
The wizard will create show/hide switches, install a Lovelace dashboard (when possible), and write `/config/skylight_calendar/dashboard_generated.yaml` as a backup.

Also install via HACS (Frontend): **Week Planner Card Plus**, Bubble Card, Config Template Card, card-mod, Better Moment Card — then hard-refresh the browser.
